title: Synthetic Data Fairness
summary: A research codebase studying fairness properties of synthetically generated tabular data across datasets like CARDIO, CREDIT, and ACS Traveltime, wrapping generators in an imblearn-style SDVGenerator sampler with custom constraints. It runs SDV's GaussianCopula and TVAE single-table synthesizers (with CTGAN present but commented out) and uses sdv.metadata.Metadata and sdv.constraints as the core data-generation engine.
evidence: experiments/results.py:28-31 'from sdv.single_table import GaussianCopulaSynthesizer, TVAESynthesizer'; synfair/synthetic_data/_sdv.py wraps them in SDVGenerator
needs: CTGANSynthesizer import is commented out in results.py, so CTGAN itself is not confirmed to run.
